dd3b8b08b9ef241b039249c3567a4f9376c32d32.summary: Blog post by a malware analyst who was hunting Gootkit on a Nuclear Pack exploit kit instance in France in March 2015 and instead found a new ransomware, CryptoFortress. The author compares it with TorrentLocker (also called Teerac.A), notes a close match in design, and lists two samples and two later write-ups by Eset and CertLexsi.
